title: Copilot Studio: credit costs per agent and by lifecycle stage in the Monitor tab
summary: Hold: an environment allocation is presented as a spending cap without explaining that tenant-capacity draw and pay-as-you-go can allow continued consumption. The page also incorrectly calls Monitor a maker's first cost view and says testing spend is not capped, and both administration paths omit documented navigation steps.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance controls
claims.claim: The environment allocation is a cap that bounds spend and can stop the agent.
claims.quote: An allocation isn't a boundary if the environment can continue drawing from tenant capacity or pay-as-you-go billing.
claims.fix: Replace 'Caps are the per-agent monthly limit and the environment allocation (see the controls table)' with 'An agent monthly limit can stop usage when Stop usage is enabled. An environment allocation caps prepaid consumption only when tenant-capacity draw is off; consumption can still continue through a linked pay-as-you-go plan.' Apply the same qualification to the statements that the environment allocation stops agents or bounds spend in Risk assessment and Governance controls. The qualification is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/manage-usage-microsoft-copilot-harness#choose-cost-controls.

claims.claim: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 writes an environment allocation using MCSMessages, an allocation quantity and a TenantPool enforcement rule.
